sentences.text: The documents do not state clause 7.4, so compliance with RBI pre-payment rules cannot be determined from the supplied materials.
For a floating rate loan to an individual for non_business purpose sanctioned on 2026-01-01, UCB Responsible Business Conduct Directions, 2025 para 261(1) says a prepayment charge is not permitted.
The business-purpose rule in para 261(2) does not cover this case because the case facts are non_business.
